Get started with Databricks Free Edition in this comprehensive walkthrough where we explore the platform’s interface, key features, and how to navigate both the technical and business-friendly views.
What you will learn:
• How to sign up and log in to Databricks Free Edition using Google, Microsoft, or email
• Overview of the main workspace areas: notebooks, recent items, Unity Catalog, and data catalog navigation
• How to create and manage jobs, pipelines, and ETL processes in the Jobs & Pipelines section
• Using the SQL editor, dashboards, and query history for quick data analysis
